title: Simpler Methods Work Better for L1 Penalized Logistic Models and Large Datasets
abstract: arXiv:2609.23995v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Linear models with an $L_1$-norm penalty remain state-of-the-art for high-dimensional ($d > 1,000,000$) tasks, offering a straightforward method for solving real-world industry problems. Despite their widespread use in industry and utility, many $L_1$ solvers are not effective for general use, are prohibitively slow, and are ineffective in parallelization. This makes them difficult to train in an MLOps pipeline on large industry-scale corpora. In this work, we test several proposed ``state-of-the-art'' solutions from the literature and find that older methods are currently far superior for general use. We also identify several recommendations for academics to perform research that avoids erroneously overconfident results, which can prevent the transition to production use. Equally surprising, we find that a new and simple baseline, using LBFGS on a sub-gradient, is highly effective with minor tweaks, despite being dismissed in the litera

translated_title: 更简单的方法在L1惩罚逻辑模型和大型数据集上效果更好
translated_abstract: 具有L1范数惩罚的线性模型在高维（d > 1,000,000）任务中仍然是最先进的方法，为解决现实世界的工业问题提供了一种直接的方法。尽管它们在工业界和实际应用中被广泛使用，但许多L1求解器在通用性上并不有效，速度极慢，且难以并行化。这使得它们难以在MLOps流水线中对大规模工业级语料库进行训练。在这项工作中，我们测试了文献中提出的几种“最先进”的解决方案，发现较旧的方法目前在通用性方面远远优于它们。我们还为学术界提出了几项建议，以帮助开展避免错误且过度自信结果的研究，因为这类结果可能会阻碍方法向生产环境的过渡。同样令人惊讶的是，我们发现一个新的简单基线方法——在次梯度上使用LBFGS——只需稍作调整就非常有效，尽管该方法在文献中曾被否定。
tldr: 本研究通过实证测试发现，对于大规模高维数据的L1惩罚逻辑回归，传统旧方法以及基于次梯度的简单LBFGS基线方法实际上远优于文献中声称的“最先进”求解器，并为学术界避免过度自信的研究结论提出了建议。
en_tdlr: For L1-penalized logistic models on large high-dimensional datasets, older traditional methods and a simple sub-gradient LBFGS baseline prove far more effective than the supposedly state-of-the-art solvers proposed in recent literature, with recommendations for academics to avoid erroneously overconfident research results.
